text: FeynAmpDenominatorSplit[expr] splits all FeynAmpDenominator[a,b, ...] in expr into FeynAmpDenominator[a]*FeynAmpDenominator[b]*... . FeynAmpDenominatorSplit[expr, Momentum ->q1] splits all FeynAmpDenominator in expr into two products, one containing q1 and other momenta, the second being free of q1.
FAD[q1, q1 - p, q1 - q2, q2, q2 - p] ex = FeynAmpDenominatorSplit[%]
ex // FCE // StandardForm (*FAD[q1] FAD[-p + q1] FAD[q1 - q2] FAD[q2] FAD[-p + q2]*)
ex = FeynAmpDenominatorSplit[FAD[q1, q1 - p, q1 - q2, q2, q2 - p], Momentum -> {q1}]
ex // FCE // StandardForm (*FAD[q2, -p + q2] FAD[q1, -p + q1, q1 - q2]*)
FeynAmpDenominatorCombine[ex] // FCE // StandardForm (*FAD[q1, q2, -p + q1, q1 - q2, -p + q2]*)
